PockPock Agent 0.2.15 makes PockPock Agent and the OpenClaw agent finish whole tasks. In real runs with local models, plans often failed partway: tool errors were lost, files were written to the wrong folder, and the planner made mistakes that guaranteed a failed step. One run also reported a bug fixed while its tests still failed. This release fixes those problems.

## Download

| Your computer | Download |
|---|---|
| Windows 10 or 11 (64-bit) | [PockPock-Agent-Setup.exe](https://github.com/PockPock9/PockPockAgent/releases/latest/download/PockPock-Agent-Setup.exe) |
| Mac with Apple silicon (M1 or newer) | [PockPock-Agent-mac-arm64.dmg](https://github.com/PockPock9/PockPockAgent/releases/latest/download/PockPock-Agent-mac-arm64.dmg) |
| Mac with an Intel processor | [PockPock-Agent-mac-x64.dmg](https://github.com/PockPock9/PockPockAgent/releases/latest/download/PockPock-Agent-mac-x64.dmg) |

**Already using 0.2.14 on Windows?** PockPock updates itself: press **Restart to update** when it appears, or check in **Settings → Updates**. Your chats, settings, models and caches are kept. On a Mac, download and install it once, the same way as the first time.

**New to PockPock?** Open the downloaded file, then press **Set up PockPock**; setup installs everything else. Windows may show **"Windows protected your PC"** because PockPock is not code-signed yet: press **More info**, then **Run anyway**. On a Mac, see the [installation guide](https://github.com/PockPock9/PockPockAgent/wiki/Installation).

## What's new since 0.2.14

### Tested on real tasks

Each mode ran a set of tasks with local models, and the results were checked, not just the reported status:

| Mode | Models | Finished |
|---|---|---|
| Plan in steps | `qwen3.8:27b` plans, `qwen3.5:9b` works | 7 of 7 |
| One model plans and works | `qwen3.5:9b` | 7 of 7 |
| OpenClaw | `qwen3.5:9b` | 3 of 3 |

The tasks:
- a restaurant website, with a folder open and without;
- a summary of a notes file;
- a resume page made from a text file;
- a to-do web app that remembers its list;
- a sales report from a CSV file;
- a bug fix checked by the project's tests.

### No more false "done"

- A step meant to change files must actually change one. A "fix the code" step used to pass after only reading a file.
- In **Full access**, Plan in steps can run your project's checks and tests, as one-model runs already could.
- If the Validator service isn't running, a check step now fails with a clear message. Before, it passed without checking anything.

### Fewer failed steps

- Tool errors reach the agent again. Before, an internal error hid every tool error, so the agent couldn't correct itself.
- With a folder open, files are written into that folder, not saved elsewhere.
- The planner's common mistakes are corrected before the plan runs:
  - web tools for a request that names no website;
  - an image tool for a file that isn't an image;
  - steps waiting for you to reply;
  - read-only steps checked for text they can't write;
  - inputs that name no earlier step.
- Image steps are left out of the plan when no image generator (ComfyUI or Stable Diffusion WebUI) is running.
- Retries say exactly what's missing, such as the file name or the text to include. A retry can also replace a file the same task saved.
- `.csv`, `.tsv` and `.log` files in the open folder can be read.
- Slow local models get more time per step, especially the first step, while the model loads.

### OpenClaw

- OpenClaw stops after 6 actions in a row fail, and says which action failed last, instead of looping.

## Good to know

- The pull request passed the full check suite (backend tests, and the desktop typecheck and build, on Ubuntu, Windows and macOS).
- Not tested yet: tasks that need web research, or many approvals.
- Help is in the [wiki](https://github.com/PockPock9/PockPockAgent/wiki). Please [report problems](https://github.com/PockPock9/PockPockAgent/issues/new/choose).
